SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l_all.ALP) AS average_ALP, AVG(l_all.HCT) AS average_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l_all ON l_all.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS qualifying
    WHERE qualifying.ID = p.ID
      AND qualifying.`U-PRO` = '-'
      AND qualifying.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY average_HCT IS NULL ASC, average_HCT DESC
LIMIT 10;
